name: Bloodmage: Atherann's Wickedness raises Shadow damage, hit chance and Atherann's Anguish (#2332)
contract: Atherann's Wickedness 704642 (rank 1) and 707865 (rank 2): "Increases your Shadow damage dealt by $s1% and increases your hit chance by $s2%." Effect 0 is aura 79 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE with MiscValue 32 = Shadow, amount 4 / 8, handled by AuraEffect::HandleModDamagePercentDone (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:144). Effect 1 is aura 333 ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT, amount 3 / 6, handled by AuraEffect::HandleAscensionModHitChanceAll (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:398) and consumed in StatSystem.cpp at 998/1004/1010 for melee, ranged and spell hit. 704643: "Increases the damage of Atherann's Anguish by $s1%" - one aura 108 effect, MiscValue 0 = SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, amount 20, EffectSpellClassMask [0, 65536, 0], which over SpellFamilyName 26 selects exactly one record, Atherann's Anguish 500448. The damage probe is Bloodmoon Blast 500125, SchoolMask 32 = Shadow. Confirmed natively in .agents/plans/bloodmage-sanguine/verify-native.md:319-340; this is its regression scenario. NOT COVERED HERE: the delivered +20% on 500448. 704643 is the one of the three records that is not passive - Attributes 0x180 is SPELL_ATTR0_DO_NOT_DISPLAY | SPELL_ATTR0_DO_NOT_LOG with no SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE 0x40, and Stances is 0 - so Player::addSpell (Player.cpp:3363) does not self-cast it at learn and no spell in this repository grants it either. Fixturing the aura does not work around that: its DurationIndex is 0, SpellDuration.dbc has no row 0, so SpellInfo::GetDuration returns 0, Aura::IsExpired is immediately true and Unit::_UpdateSpells (Unit.cpp:4245) removes the aura on the next world tick - before the harness runs the following step, since it executes one step per OnUpdate. With no applied aura there is no SPELLMOD_DAMAGE entry in Player::m_spellMods, so the spell_modifier metric can never see the 20%. This scenario therefore locks the shipped magnitude of the record only; the applied modifier needs a Ghost e2e test on a character that has actually been granted 704643 in game, comparing Atherann's Anguish combat-log damage with and without it.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Nothing in this fixture modifies Atherann's Anguish
Rank 1 raises spell hit chance by 3 points
Rank 1 raises melee hit chance by 3 points
Rank 2 raises spell hit chance by 6 points
